mn64:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn64:2.1: dhāretha no tumhe bhikkhave, mayā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti.
mn64:2.2: evaṃ vutte āyasmā māluṅkyaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn64:2.3: ‘ahaṃ kho bhante dhāremi bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānī’ti.
mn64:2.4: yathā kathaṃ pana tvaṃ māluṅkyaputta, dhāresi mayā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānī’ti.
mn64:2.5: sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.6: vicikicchaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.7: sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi,
mn64:2.8: kāmacchandaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi,
mn64:2.9: byāpādaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, bhagavatā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ desitaṃ dhāremi.
mn64:2.10: evaṃ kho ahaṃ bhante, dhāremi bhagavatā desitāni pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanānīti.
mn64:3.1: kassa kho nāma tvaṃ māluṅkyaputta, mayā evaṃ pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni desitāni dhāresi.
mn64:3.2: nanu māluṅkyaputta, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇūpamena upārambhena upārambhissanti.
mn64:3.3: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sakkāyotipi na hoti. kuto panassa uppajjissati sakkāyadiṭṭhi.
mn64:3.5: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa dhammātipi na hoti. kuto panassa uppajjissati dhammesu vicikicchā,
mn64:3.7: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sīlātipi na hoti. kuto panassa uppajjissati sīlesu sīlabbataparāmāso.
mn64:3.9: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa kāmātipi na hoti. kuto panassa uppajjissati kāmesu kāmacchando,
mn64:3.11: daharassa hi māluṅkyaputta, kumārassa mandassa uttānaseyyakassa sattātipi na hoti, kuto panassa uppajjissati sattesu byāpādo,
mn64:3.13: nanu māluṅkyaputta, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā iminā taruṇūpamena upārambhena upārambhissantīti.
mn64:4.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn64:4.2: etassa bhagavā kālo, etassa sugata kālo,
mn64:4.3: yaṃ bhagavā pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni deseyya. bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
mn64:4.4: tena hānanda suṇāhi sādhukaṃ manasi karohi bhāsissāmīti.
mn64:4.5: evaṃ bhanteti, kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
mn64:5.1: idhānanda, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto, sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto,
mn64:5.3: uppannāya ca sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn64:5.4: tassa sā sakkāyadiṭṭhi thāmagatā appaṭivinītā orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ,
mn64:5.6: uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn64:5.7: tassa sā vicikicchā thāmagatā appaṭivinītā orambhāgiyaṃ saññojanaṃ.
mn64:5.9: uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
mn64:5.10: tassa so sīlabbataparāmāso thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:5.12: uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti,
mn64:5.13: tassa so kāmarāgo thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:5.15: uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti,
mn64:5.16: tassa so byāpādo thāmagato appaṭivinīto orambhāgiyaṃ saṃyojanaṃ.
mn64:6.1: sutavā ca kho ānanda ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto, sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto, na sakkāyadiṭṭhipariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na sakkāyadiṭṭhiparetena,
mn64:6.2: uppannāya ca sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
mn64:6.4: na vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na vicikicchāparetena.
mn64:6.5: uppannāya ca vicikicchāya nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
mn64:6.7: na sīlabbataparāmāsapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na sīlabbataparāmāsaparetena,
mn64:6.8: uppannassa ca sīlabbataparāmāsassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
mn64:6.10: na kāmarāgapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na kāmarāgaparetena,
mn64:6.11: uppannassa ca kāmarāgassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
mn64:6.13: na byāpādapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati na byāpādaparetena,
mn64:6.14: uppannassa ca byāpādassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti,
mn64:6.16: yo ānanda, maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya, taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ anāgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhiti, vā pajahissati vāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn64:6.17: seyyathāpi ānanda, mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato tacaṃ acchetvā phegguṃ acchetvā sāracchedo bhavissatīti
mn64:6.19: evameva kho ānanda, yo maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ anāgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhiti vā pajahissati vāti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
mn64:7.1: yo ca kho ānanda, maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ āgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni ñassati vā dakkhiti vā pajahissati vāti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn64:8.1: seyyathāpi ānanda, mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato tacaṃ chetvā phegguṃ chetvā sāracchedo bhavissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
mn64:8.2: evameva kho ānanda, yo maggo yā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya taṃ maggaṃ taṃ paṭipadaṃ āgamma pañcorambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni ñassati vā dakkhiti vā pajahissati vāti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
mn64:8.3: seyyathāpi ānanda, gaṅgā nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā,
mn64:8.5: ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gacchāmī’ti
mn64:8.6: so na sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ.
mn64:8.7: evameva kho ānanda, yassa kassaci sakkāya nirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ na pakkhandati, nappasīdati, na santiṭṭhati, na vimuccati.
mn64:8.8: seyyathāpi so dubbalako puriso evamete daṭṭhabbā.
mn64:8.9: seyyathāpi ānanda, gaṅgā nadī pūrā udakassa samatittikā kākapeyyā.
mn64:8.11: ahaṃ imissā gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gacchāmī’ti.
mn64:8.12: so sakkuṇeyya gaṅgāya nadiyā tiriyaṃ bāhāya sotaṃ chetvā sotthinā pāraṃ gantuṃ.
mn64:8.13: evameva kho ānanda yassa kassaci sakkāya nirodhāya dhamme desiyamāne cittaṃ pakkhandati, pasīdati, santiṭṭhati, vimuccati.
mn64:8.14: seyyathāpi so balavā puriso evamete daṭṭhabbā.
mn64:9.1: katamo cānanda, maggo katamā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya:
mn64:9.2: idhānanda bhikkhu upadhivivekā akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānā sabbaso kāyaduṭṭhullānaṃ paṭippassaddhiyā vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn64:9.3: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ. te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
mn64:9.5: so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati.
mn64:9.6: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānanti.
mn64:9.8: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.
mn64:9.9: ayampi kho ānanda, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya.
mn64:10-12.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe…
mn64:10-12.4: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ
mn64:10-12.7: ayampi kho ānanda, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ pahānāya.
mn64:13.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn64:13.2: so yadeva tattha hoti vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ
mn64:13.5: ayampi kho ānanda, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya.
mn64:14.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda, bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn64:15.1: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn64:15.2: so yadeva tattha hoti vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ
mn64:15.3: te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpeti. so tehi dhammehi cittaṃ paṭivāpetvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharati: etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṃkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānanti. so tatthaṭṭhito āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti. teneva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī
mn64:15.5: ayaṃ kho ānanda, maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāyāti.
mn64:16.1: eso ce bhante, maggo esā paṭipadā pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ pahānāya atha kiñcarahi idhekacce bhikkhū cetovimuttino ekacce bhikkhū paññāvimuttinoti.
mn64:16.2: ettha kho tesāhaṃ ānanda, indriyavemattataṃ vadāmīti.
mn64:16.4: attamano āyasmā ānando bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti.
